issues.description: Template code does not compile because Stock.addToStockIngredients(...) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...), but the template's ArrayHelpers only defines appendElement(...). As a result, students cannot build/run the provided starter code before implementing their own parts.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name in the template: either rename ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...), or change Stock.addToStockIngredients(...) to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...). Ensure all template call sites use the same name.

issues.description: The problem statement is internally inconsistent about SealSaloon.stock: it first says SealSaloon has a 'final Stock stock' attribute, but then explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static (shared across all instances). The UML association also suggests an instance attribute. This contradiction can lead students to implement stock as instance final, static final, or instance non-final, affecting required method signatures (static vs instance) and grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent by stating one clear requirement everywhere (UML + text): either (a) 'private static final Stock stock' and keep related methods static, or (b) 'private final Stock stock' as an instance field and remove the requirement that stock/methods must be static.
